title: armed AtomicBool mirrors Phase::Loading, set by hand beside the phase change
trigger: LockedDown sets phase=Loading and armed=true in two statements; Closing never clears armed
effect: none today (Closing returns before any armed event is read)
fix: derive armed from Phase by storing Phase in the shared atomic (AtomicU8 phase) so one value changes

title: quill://unread watcher thread sleeps in a loop (WATCH_WAIT) while Quill is locked or signed out
trigger: An agent subscribes to quill://unread, the user locks Quill or signs out
effect: A detached per-connection thread wakes every 10 s doing nothing until the connection ends; bounded by the connection and 4 connections
fix: park the watcher on crate::wake::AGENT (wake_wait::sleep_or_wake) instead of a bare sleep

title: td_call offset tokens are not dropped when an account logs out; keys are reused
trigger: Agent runs searchMessages through td_call, user logs out; another Telegram user signs in under the same account-<n> key; the same agent replays the old quill-offset token
effect: Token is bound to account.0+agent+method, so reveal() accepts it and passes the old user's offset (date,chat_id,message_id) into the new account's request; results stay redacted by grants, so only a wrong page
fix: add td_offset::forget_account to account_data::forget (or bind the token to client_id)

title: ArchiveReload::Suggested holds no RequestId and is a bridge stage until the caller invokes note_sent
trigger: note_suggested is called and no send follows; or a second note_suggested arrives while Reloading(id) is in flight
effect: stage sticks in Suggested until the next suggestion or note_reload_failed(None); a second suggestion can overwrite an in-flight Reloading stage and drop its request
fix: hold the request in the stage, or send inside the transition so there is no bridge state

title: baseline: PlaybackHealth::output_failed bool beside frames/peak
trigger: Output device fails during a stream call
effect: No bug today: the watch reads the bool once per observe and moves WatchStage to Reopened; the flag is a sampled fact, not a stage held by hand
fix: an OutputState { Open, Failed } enum on the stream player, or drop it into FallBack

title: EditImageFetch::Downloading waits on download tracker phase Ended only; a Cancelled or dropped intent never leaves the stage
trigger: Edit a sent photo, choose Edit Image (photo not on disk), then cancel that file's download from another surface (phase Cancelled) or the intent is cleared
effect: edit_image_upkeep never sees landed or ended_without_file, so Downloading stays until the edit box closes and Edit Image does nothing further
fix: hold a RequestId/Task in Downloading, or make ended_without_file also true for Cancelled/missing intent

title: ReplacementProbe::Probing holds a global u64 ProbeJob counter while the probe task is detached
trigger: Edit a message, stage a replacement video (probe starts), then replace it again or clear it
effect: No stuck state: the stale answer is dropped by comparing the counter, but the superseded ffprobe still runs to the end (wasted work) because the stage holds a counter, not the task. EditRender::Rendering beside it holds a RenderJob that cancels on drop
fix: Probing { job: TaskHold } (like RenderJob) so leaving the stage drops the probe; compare by token

title: SoundSlot matches a landing output by a Wanted::generation u64, while the DeviceThread that owns the open is held elsewhere
trigger: Reopen the call or stream sound (device switch, self-heal reopen) while the previous open is still running
effect: No wrong output today: publish() drops a stale open whose generation moved on. The counter stands in for the identity of the DeviceThread, which cannot cancel an open already in progress
fix: let the DeviceThread own a token the slot compares (like RenderToken), so the stage and the answer share one identity

title: fetch_chat_lists_to_add_chat begins the Fetch but never records the RequestId (begin() without sent(extra)); in-flight is matched by chat id via has_purpose_for_chat
trigger: open the add-to-folder menu for a chat, then the request is answered or dropped
effect: Loading stage holds no request; a dropped answer cannot be told from a live one, and the answer is matched by purpose+chat instead of the stage's RequestId
fix: call fetch.sent(extra) like fetch_chat_folder_chats_to_leave does and match the answer by the held RequestId

title: probe_self_star_stats calls self_stats.begin() but never sent(request); the Loading stage holds no RequestId and the guard is has_purpose(StarStats{peer})
trigger: open the profile/earn entry with my user id; the StarStats answer is matched by purpose+peer
effect: stage cannot tell its own request from another StarStats{peer} request; a dropped answer leaves Loading with nothing to expire it
fix: self_stats.sent(request) after begin, like app_config in ensure_earn_app_config

title: change_collectible_emoji_status resets StatusChange to Idle and never enters StatusChange::Setting, unlike change_emoji_status
trigger: pick a collectible emoji status; a second SetEmojiStatus answer is only ignored because of the has_purpose guard
effect: StatusChange::Setting{request,emoji} is set on one of two send paths; the collectible path has no stage, so its answer neither remembers pack usage nor is matched by RequestId
fix: enter Setting{request, emoji} on both paths (one helper) or delete the stage if nothing reads it

title: fetch_folder_share does not wait for an in-flight DeleteChatFolderInviteLink; nothing refetches after the delete answers
trigger: delete a folder invite link, close Share Folder and reopen it before the delete answers; getChatFolderInviteLinks is sent while the delete is out and its answer still lists the link
effect: the deleted link reappears in the Share Folder box (as Ready) until the box is reopened again
fix: treat a pending delete as part of the links stage (links Outdated until the delete answers, refetch on its answer), or have fetch_folder_share defer while has_purpose_for_folder(Delete...)

title: pump_one_group_call re-sends the engine mute/camera change every pump after it failed (state map only updated on Ok)
trigger: join a group call where the engine refuses set_group_muted or set_group_camera (no camera, device busy); pump_connected_group_calls runs from request_tick
effect: the engine call is retried on every tick while the call lasts (wasted work, repeated engine/device errors); the user sees the stale error note and no retry cap
fix: hold a per-call Applied/Failed{wanted} stage so a failed change is retried on a user action or timer, not every tick

title: begin_close/release_close drop the error of request_close; a refused close leaves ShutdownPhase::Running and the client waits with nothing left to retry
trigger: quit or switch accounts while the sender refuses the close request (native send fails)
effect: the closing client stays Pending until the receive bridge is seen as lost; no retry of the close request
fix: make a failed close send a ShutdownPhase variant that retries on the next drain or reports Lost

title: disk-paused downloads are tracked in three structures changed by hand together: media.disk_paused (runtime set), data_storage.disk_paused (persisted set) and media.disk_paused_persisted (last saved copy)
trigger: disk goes Low then Healthy, a pause/resume succeeds for some files and a toggle send fails midway
effect: note_disk, pause_download, save_disk_pause/forget_disk_pause and resume_disk_paused_found each touch a different subset; a failed toggle leaves the runtime set and the persisted set out of step until the next ingest repairs it
fix: one DiskPaused owner with pause/resume/commit methods and a dirty marker

title: fetch_poll_option_properties sets poll_option_menu.properties to Loading{request: None} before sending and never records or clears it when the send fails
trigger: open the menu of a poll option while the sender refuses the request
effect: the option menu stays in a request-less Loading stage (no link/delete rows) until the menu is reopened; its answer is matched by chat+message+option_key instead of the RequestId
fix: begin the menu after the send with fetch.sent(extra), and fail it on a refused send

title: request_deep_link_text_from starts a new deep-link stage without the in-flight check request_deep_link_info_from makes
trigger: a pasted text link is looked up while another deep link is ResolvingInfo, ResolvingChat or showing an InvitePreview
effect: start_deep_link replaces the stage whole: the earlier request's answer no longer matches and is dropped, and an open invite preview vanishes
fix: share one guard (refuse while the stage is in flight) between the two entry points

title: revoke_public_link sends the username clear, then fails the whole stage when the second send (disable all usernames) is refused
trigger: revoke a public group link while the second request cannot be sent
effect: the box reports a failed revoke although setSupergroupUsername("") already went out; the link is gone on the server and the UI shows the old state until refetched
fix: keep the first request in the Revoking stage and report a partial result, or send both from one batch

title: new_community_photo is a one-shot slot (RequestId, path) filled when a create is sent and only taken by a successful create answer
trigger: create a community with a photo and the create request fails or its answer is dropped (account switch)
effect: the slot keeps a stale (request, path) pair until the next create overwrites it; nothing clears it on failure
fix: hold the photo in the create request's stage so a failed or dropped create releases it

title: In-chat search still matches pages by a generation counter (begin_query/ request_chat_search(search_gen))
trigger: type a query, change query while page in flight
effect: late page of old query matched by counter not RequestId
fix: SearchStage::Searching{request:RequestId}

title: History calendar pages matched by SearchPurpose::GetChatMessageCalendar{generation} counter
trigger: open calendar, switch media tab while page in flight
effect: answer matched by counter
fix: CalendarPaging::Loading{request}

title: Bot create/check username answers matched by generation counters (CheckBotUsername/CreateBot purposes)
trigger: type username, retype while check out
effect: stale verdict matched by counter
fix: BotUsernameCheck::Checking{request:RequestId}

title: PasskeyAdd::FetchingOptions(request) and Create Passkey never checks the request still exists in session.requests (the list stage does); a lost request leaves begin_register returning Ok(None) forever
trigger: click Create Passkey, connection drops so request is lost without answer
effect: Create Passkey spins until app restart
fix: drop_lost like login stage

title: fetch_blocked_senders asks from offset = loaded length, so the "always fresh" fetch on every Privacy open never refetches page 0 once the list is loaded (and after a chat-bar Block on an unloaded list it starts at offset 1, skipping the server's first entry)
trigger: load Settings > Privacy > Blocked, block a user from another device (or block from a chat while the list is unloaded), reopen Privacy
effect: blocked list stays stale until restart; the newest server entry is never shown; has_more can stay true with a duplicate-only page
fix: offset 0 refetch on open (Fetch::Outdated) with page request tied to RequestId

title: A refused send of getStickerCategories leaves sticker_categories Idle (GetStickerCategories is not in StickerLists::for_purpose, so sticker_request cannot fail it) although the doc says a failed ask stays Failed so a render never re-asks; the panel's render-deferred fetch re-sends on every render
trigger: open sticker panel while the client refuses sends (closing client)
effect: a new getStickerCategories attempt on each render of the panel and no Failed/Retry state
fix: fail the Fetch in fetch_sticker_categories on Err

title: StickerManager::open is a session bool mirroring whether the manager box is on screen, set and cleared by hand from the UI (stickers_manager/mod.rs, masks_ui.rs) beside the box's own state; covers_requested is cleared only with it
trigger: open stickers manager, switch account or close the window without the box's close path
effect: manager.open stays true so pump_sticker_manager keeps downloading covers
fix: derive from the box (OnScreen) instead of a session flag

title: WebApps::opening is one account-wide slot: a launch from a second window overwrites the first window's still-pending launch (its answer opens nothing and its app is closed) although the launches belong to different windows
trigger: tap a mini app in the main window and another in a chat window before the first answers
effect: the first window's mini app silently never opens
fix: per-window launch stage keyed by RequestId

title: Widget query answers are matched by a caller-held u64 token in BotsPurpose::GetWidgetQueryAnswer instead of the RequestId (counter: baseline)
trigger: widget sends two queries while the first is out
effect: answer routed by counter not by request
fix: key the widget answer by RequestId

title: A keyword query that failed ATTEMPTS (2) times is given up for the whole session; failures are never reset by reconnect/online, so queries tried offline never complete after the network returns
trigger: type :smile style emoji search while offline twice then go online
effect: that query never shows keyword emoji until restart
fix: clear failures when the connection becomes Ready (or hold the query in a Failed stage with a retry clock)

title: The sticker, GIF and emoji panels each keep an `open` bool in the Session (StickerPanel::open, gifs.open, EmojiPanel::open) set by open_*_panel and cleared by close_*_panel; refresh_stale_panels and maybe_load_selected_sticker_set read it to decide what to refetch, so a panel dismissed by a path that skips close_* keeps work running while hidden
trigger: open the sticker panel then lock, switch account or close the window without the panel's close path
effect: stale-list refetches and set loads keep going for a panel nobody sees
fix: derive from the picker owned by OnScreen/ChatUi (one value), no session mirror

title: TrendingSets::Loading holds `request: Option<RequestId>` that is None between begin() and sent(): an Option used as a "went out" flag, so a caller that begins and neither sends nor fails leaves a Loading nothing can answer
trigger: emoji sets Trending tab asks while the send path returns early
effect: Loading stage with no request until a manual fail/cancel
fix: begin_with(request) after the send, or Fetch::Loading{request}

title: KeywordEmojis is one session-wide value read by every window's emoji panel through for_query: two windows searching different queries overwrite each other's list and ask again on each switch
trigger: search emoji in two windows with different words
effect: results disappear in one window when the other types
fix: per-window (WindowSlot) search stage

title: EarnState keeps one-shot slots (open_url: Option<String>, notes, effects) the UI is expected to drain; nothing clears them when the page or window that asked is gone, so a Fragment URL set after the user left the Withdraw box opens later in an unrelated frame
trigger: start a withdrawal, close the revenue page before the answer lands
effect: a browser tab opens or toast appears long after the action
fix: a stage on the Withdraw (Opened{url}) owned by the page

title: set_chat_sound/show_preview/story_* each clone chat.notification_settings from the session and send the whole object, so two changes made before updateChatNotificationSettings returns send the second from the old copy and undo the first
trigger: change a chat's sound then its preview within one round trip
effect: first notification setting silently reverts
fix: send only the changed field or hold a Saving stage with the pending settings

title: set_gift_settings stores the on-screen value as the rollback before the optimistic write; a second save before the first answers records the first optimistic value as the one to restore, so a refusal of the first restores a value the server never held
trigger: toggle two gift-privacy switches quickly while the server refuses the first
effect: a refused change shows as applied or the wrong value is restored
fix: keep the server-confirmed value in the stage and restore to it

title: MPRIS worker is started once from a OnceLock and never restarted
trigger: The `mpris` thread panics or fails to spawn; every later `set` sends into a dead channel
effect: Media keys and the Now Playing widget stop for the rest of the session (the macOS and Windows backends share the shape)
fix: a worker stage (Running/Dead) that respawns, like icon_badge's launcher_worker_runs

title: search_changed sets VenueList::Loading with Typing when there is no search location, and the debounce then sends nothing
trigger: Type in the venue search before the pin has rested once (search_location None)
effect: The list sits on Loading with no request out; the UI hides search until can_search(), so it needs a UI path that skips that gate
fix: refuse Typing while search_location is None, or fall to WaitingForLocation

title: Address.ever_shown latch sits beside AddressStage
trigger: Show an address, then move the pin
effect: Blank line reads Loading... from a flag outside the stage enum
fix: fold into AddressStage (Idle vs Idle-after-shown)

title: Presses keeps pressed and last_handled as two Options changed together
trigger: press, release, double click on the PiP picture
effect: No wrong behaviour found; both are cleared in release only
fix: one enum Idle/Held(over)/Handled(over)

title: GlyphSave::Saving names a writer thread that the stage does not hold
trigger: First chat list draw starts the glyph and line-layout writer
effect: The thread is detached; SaveEnd's Drop is the only way out of Saving, so a hung writer leaves it Saving for the run (harmless, one-shot)
fix: hold the JoinHandle in Saving

title: stale_archives_are_removed sleeps 20 ms in a test
trigger: Run the unit tests
effect: Violates the no-sleeps-in-tests rule; can flake on a coarse file clock
fix: pass a fake `now` to remove_stale instead of sleeping

title: Local MessageKey alias is a bare (chat, message) tuple, not ids::ChatMessage
trigger: EffectWatch used across accounts
effect: Session-owned so no leak today; the type would not stop a mix-up
fix: use ids::ChatMessage

title: dismissed set is keyed by bare (i64,i64)
trigger: Dismiss a force-reply bar
effect: Owned by the session so no leak found; keys are untyped
fix: ChatMessage keys

title: A Star reaction whose commit could not be sent is Stuck with no way out
trigger: Tap a paid (Star) reaction, go offline or lose the send so the commit at the 5.5 s deadline fails (connect/paid_reaction.rs commit_unsent), then do nothing more on that message.
effect: The Stars stay held by TDLib and reserved against the balance and the per-message cap (total_pending counts Stuck), but no toast, Undo or retry is shown; later reactions on other messages can be refused as NotEnough until the person taps that same message again or the session ends.
fix: Give Stuck an exit: a Retry/Undo affordance, or re-send on the next connect, tied to its RequestId; or release the reservation when the entry is abandoned.

title: baseline: GiftValueStage::Loading(u64) holds the raw @extra, not a RequestId (tuple form dodges the rawid rule)
trigger: Tap Learn more on a unique gift's Value row.
effect: No bug today: a lost request is settled by the TTL sweep as an error, which fails the stage. The stage cannot be tied to the session request table by type.
fix: Loading(RequestId); compare with pending.id; drop the unkeyed baseline line.

title: GramsHub keeps open: bool, selected: Option<String> and withdraw: Option<GramWithdraw> that close() must clear together
trigger: Open My Grams, open a receipt and Collect, close the screen.
effect: close() clears all three by hand; restart() clears selected only. The Stars box and gifts box were already folded into StarsView/GiftView, Grams was not.
fix: enum GramsView { Closed, List, Receipt(key), Withdraw(GramWithdraw) } like StarsView.

title: baseline: Rotation::Probing names a proxy id while the request lives in ProxyState::pings
trigger: Auto-switch on, connection down past the timeout; rotation_step returns Ping(id).
effect: Two places must agree: Probing{id} and pings[id]=Checking(request). Today the driver inserts Unavailable when the send fails, and PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS bounds a lost answer, so no loop; a pings clear (list refresh) while Probing would re-ping the same id at once.
fix: Probing { id, request: RequestId, asked_ms } and match the ping answer by that RequestId; drop the pings entry for rotation.

title: baseline: Lifecycle::Waiting/Loading/Running carry no request or task of their own
trigger: A widget message scrolls on screen with all MAX_LIVE sandboxes taken.
effect: Stages hold R (the UI sandbox handle) or a streak; Waiting holds nothing that is cancelled when the owner goes. No bug found: Released/Stopped/Failed all have returns.
fix: Keep as is or hold the pool ticket in Waiting; remove from stage-enums baseline once it holds one.

title: baseline: Dnd::Refreshing holds no task; a RefreshGuard on the worker thread restores it
trigger: dnd_active() is stale on Linux/Windows; a quill-dnd worker is spawned.
effect: Exit is by the guard's Drop (answer or death) and by a failed spawn; no stuck path found.
fix: Hold the JoinHandle/Task in Refreshing, or allow-list with the guard as the reason.

title: baseline: GiftsRest::Waiting holds a unix-second deadline (at) but no timer
trigger: A next page of the QR gifts panel fails.
effect: Retry is pulled by the panel after GIFTS_RETRY_SECS when it asks again; nothing owns a timer. No loop (wants_more gates).
fix: Allow-list as a pulled deadline, or hold an owned timer.

title: baseline: derived view enums GiftsLayout::Loading, OwnLinkState::Waiting and new_chat ViewState::Waiting are bare variants
trigger: Open the QR box / New Group dialog.
effect: These are computed from the real stage on each render (gifts_layout, own_link, view) and never stored, so they cannot drift.
fix: Allow-list the derived views in stage-enums-allow.txt with that reason.

title: baseline: PaidStage::Waiting is bare; its deadline commit_at_ms sits beside the stage in PendingPaid
trigger: Tap a paid reaction.
effect: The deadline is polled (due/next_change_ms); stage and deadline are one entry so they cannot disagree.
fix: Waiting { commit_at_ms } so the deadline is in the stage.

title: baseline: Neighbour::Asking(IpAddr) names a gateway but holds no request
trigger: A network change leaves a gateway whose link-layer address is unresolved.
effect: Cleared by gateways_to_resolve on the next change; macOS also reads it in still_resolving. No stuck state: the look thread is bounded by NDP_LOOKS.
fix: Allow-list: the answer is a kernel/OS event, not a Quill request.

title: baseline: BackgroundStatus::Connecting is bare
trigger: A background account's client starts.
effect: Derived from AuthorizationState by background_status on every poll, never stored as a separate flag.
fix: Allow-list as a mirrored TDLib state.

title: Linux idle sampler lifecycle is IDLE_RUNNING: AtomicBool + IDLE_LAST_READ u64::MAX sentinel + the IdleCache
trigger: Auto-lock arms (reads start the sampler), then stops reading.
effect: The thread exits when reads stop and a racing read restarts it; handled in start(). No bug found, but running/stopped is a bool beside a sentinel Option.
fix: One AtomicU8 sampler state (Stopped/Running/Stopping) or an owned thread handle.

title: A failed write of the trusted Star prices is not retried until the next price change
trigger: Confirm a paid send with 'don't ask again' when the app root is read-only or the disk is full.
effect: trust_file becomes SaveFailed; trust_to_write only returns text while Dirty, so the price is trusted this session only and the person is asked again next run. The error line is shown, so it self-corrects.
fix: Treat SaveFailed as Dirty for the next write tick, with a backoff.

title: Watch::Watching names a watcher thread nothing holds
trigger: Linux: a screen-reader query starts the D-Bus watcher with spawn_guarded and its handle is dropped; the thread blocks on the bus and ends only through EndGuard
effect: If the thread ends without running EndGuard the stage stays Watching and the watcher is never restarted
fix: Watch::Watching { thread: JoinHandle } polled with is_finished, like window_save::Writer::Running

title: baseline: RichHtmlStage::Running is bare
trigger: Save a rich message as HTML: the stage is a bare Running in an Arc<Mutex>, the worker thread is detached
effect: None today; leaving the owner cannot cancel the worker except through the WorkerLink drop
fix: RichHtmlStage::Running { job: JoinHandle or TaskHold }

title: baseline: Beats::Running { count } is a counter, not a request
trigger: A second launch forwards its args; serve() marks the counter and waits for it to move
effect: None today
fix: Running { last_beat: Instant }, or allow-list the counter with a reason

title: baseline: RowDownload::Running(Transfer) is keyed by dictionary code only
trigger: Download a dictionary, fail, retry: progress is matched by the code string, not by the download that owns it
effect: None today (one download at a time)
fix: Running { download: Progress handle / Task, code }

title: baseline: Writer::Running { in_flight } holds no thread
trigger: A settings save spawns a detached drain thread; WriterExit resets the stage only on panic
effect: None today
fix: Running { thread: JoinHandle, in_flight }

title: install() replaces the .aff before the .dic, so a failure between them leaves a mismatched pair
trigger: Re-download an installed dictionary while the .dic is held open (Windows): the new .aff is renamed in, the .dic rename fails
effect: The dictionary parses wrongly or not at all until the next successful download, yet discover_dictionaries lists it
fix: Stage both files as .part, then rename the pair, undoing the first on failure

title: InstantViewAsk entries are not removed when the getWebPageInstantView request is lost
trigger: Click an Instant View link, then the request is dropped by a flood-retry give-up or an account drain (settle_lost_request)
effect: messages.instant_view_requests keeps the entry (URL) for good and the click opens neither the reader nor the browser fallback
fix: Remove the entry in settle_lost_request, or carry the ask on the PendingRequest

title: baseline: BotUsernameCheck/CreateBotState/CreateSubmission match answers by a generation counter, not a RequestId
trigger: Type a bot username, edit it before the check answers
effect: Answer dropped by counter compare; works today but is the counter shape
fix: Checking{request: RequestId}, Creating{request}

title: known: in-chat search matches pages by ChatSearchState::generation counter (plus pending.chat_id)
trigger: Search, change query, old page answers
effect: Old answer dropped by counter; set_sender/set_media do not bump generation themselves
fix: ChatSearchPhase::Searching{request}, ChatSearchPaging::Loading{request}

title: BotEditTexts keeps asked:(RequestId,RequestId) beside BotText::Loading(id), and saved:u8 counter
trigger: Open bot edit; ids duplicated in two places
effect: No bug today; two copies of the same request ids
fix: drop asked, derive from BotText::Loading

title: ChatListState::archive_settings_open bool mirrors the ArchiveSettings dialog box that open_box(DialogKind::ArchiveSettings) already owns
trigger: Open Archive settings, switch account (closer resets flag by hand in settings_state.rs), or close via box host only
effect: No bug today (closers exist); open stage lives in two places, session flag + box host, set by hand from settings_ui.rs
fix: drop the flag; derive open from the box host / OnScreen

title: handled_add_requests is only cleared by 'process all', so a chat that asks again after an approve/reject is filtered out of the requests page
trigger: Reject a chat's add request, the chat asks again, reopen the community requests list
effect: The new request never shows in the list this session (apply_add_chat_requests_page skips handled chat ids)
fix: key the handled mark by request/page answer, or drop the mark when the server returns the chat again

title: A failed SearchDiskPausedDownloads resets DiskSearch to NotAsked, so every healthy disk reading re-sends it
trigger: Saved disk pauses exist, TDLib refuses searchFileDownloads (error); the periodic disk poll runs on a healthy disk
effect: The 'once per session' search is re-sent at the disk-poll cadence for as long as the error lasts
fix: DiskSearch::Failed{at} (retry with backoff) or Done on a definite error

title: baseline: message calendar matched by calendar_generation counter in SearchPurpose::GetChatMessageCalendar{generation}
trigger: Open the calendar, change month/chat while a page is out
effect: Stale pages dropped by counter compare; works today
fix: HistoryCalendar::Loading{request: RequestId}

title: baseline: BotLookup matches its three Fetch parts by a generation counter, not the RequestIds the Fetches hold
trigger: Type in the business-bot search box while a part is out
effect: A stale part is dropped by counter compare; each Fetch already holds its RequestId
fix: drop generation; the three Fetch requests are the guard

title: baseline: blocked-senders pages matched by blocked_generation counter (SettingsPurpose::GetBlockedSenders{generation})
trigger: Block/unblock while a blocked-list page is out
effect: Old page dropped by counter compare
fix: Paged blocked list holding the page RequestId

title: data_storage_dirty bool is a 'needs a disk write' mark the reducer sets and the driver takes; a failed write drops the mark
trigger: Presets seed lands on a read-only folder
effect: Failure is said once on the page and the mark is gone; the settings stay unsaved until the next change
fix: DataStoragePersist{Clean,Dirty,Failed} enum

title: baseline: SettingsState::pending_attention bool (allow-listed one-shot dock-bounce event)
trigger: Notification arrives in the background
effect: No bug; one-shot bool drained by take
fix: an event queue / Notifier::attention() event

title: StickersManager::open bool is a box-open flag in the account Session (same shape as archive_settings_open)
trigger: Open the stickers manager, switch account and back
effect: A closer (settings_state.rs) resets it by hand; open stage lives in the Session beside the box host
fix: derive open from the box host / OnScreen

title: baseline: Fetch::Loading.request is an Option (None between begin() and sent()), so the in-flight variant can hold no request
trigger: Any caller that does begin() and then fails to send before sent()
effect: Loading{request:None} matches no answer and nothing clears it but cancel()/fail(); callers seen send first, then begin()+sent() together
fix: Loading{request: RequestId} built by one begin_with(request) call

title: baseline: StoryFetch::Asked holds no RequestId (unkeyed)
trigger: A story fetch answered or lost
effect: Cleared by story_arrived/failed/forget_outcomes by story key; no request match
fix: Asked{request: RequestId}

title: baseline: CalendarPaging::Loading holds no request; stale pages dropped by HistoryCalendar::generation counter
trigger: Open the date calendar, change media filter/month while a page is out
effect: Counter compare drops the old page; Loading carries no RequestId
fix: CalendarPaging::Loading{request: RequestId}

title: PollOptionMenu.properties answered by (chat, message, option_key) from the purpose, not by a RequestId held in the stage
trigger: Open the option menu, close, reopen the same option while the first getPollOptionProperties is out
effect: The older answer fills the newer menu (same data, so harmless today)
fix: Fetch::Loading{request} compared against pending.id

title: MenuActions caches Know::Failed per message until 16 other entries evict it, so a failed getMessageProperties is never retried for that message
trigger: Right-click a message while offline/erroring, then again after reconnecting
effect: Menu keeps the fail-closed actions (no revoke) until the entry is evicted or forgotten
fix: Failed{at} with backoff, or drop on reconnect

title: add_members_failed and member_action_error are answered per chat id, not per request
trigger: Add members / change a member's status in a chat, two actions overlap
effect: A late error line can land on the newer action's box
fix: per-action stage holding the RequestId

title: Date jump (getChatMessageByDate) answer is matched by purpose; DateJumpAnswer holds no RequestId
trigger: Pick date A in the Jump to date box, then date B before A's getChatMessageByDate answers; both answers go through accept_date_message/fail_date_jump with only the purpose checked
effect: The later-arriving answer overwrites search.date_jump, so a stale day can win over the newest pick (the driver consumes each Resolved jump in arrival order)
fix: DateJumpAnswer::Asking{request} set when the request is sent; apply/fail only when pending.id equals it

title: resetNetworkStatistics ok rewrites an in-flight network fetch to Loading{request:None}, then the pre-reset answer lands through the unmatched succeed
trigger: Open Network usage (getNetworkStatistics in flight), reset the usage, and the reset ok arrives before the fetch answer
effect: The stage holds no request, so the old fetch answer is applied by Fetch::succeed (no request check) and the panel shows the numbers from before the reset until it is reopened
fix: On reset call network.begin()/sent(new request) for a refetch (or drop to Idle and cancel the old request) so only the post-reset answer is matched by RequestId

title: Submit::Sending reads a failure only while the registry still remembers it; an evicted failure reads Done
trigger: A box sends Save; the request fails but the box is not polled until 64 other requests failed after it (FAILURES_KEPT), e.g. a hidden/background window.
effect: view() finds no failure and no pending request, so it returns SubmitView::Done and the box closes as if saved, losing the typed form and the error.
fix: Have the answer/error path settle the owning Submit (or keep failures until their Submit reads them) instead of inferring Done from absence in the registry.

title: StickerSelection keeps set_id and stage.set_id in step by hand
trigger: selection.set_id is assigned separately from stage; selected_needs_load compares the two to decide whether to ask.
effect: No bug today; a code path that sets one without the other either never loads or loads again.
fix: Make the stage the only holder of the set id (Idle becomes Selected{set_id} before the ask).

title: AttachedStickers is a dead duplicate of AttachedSets
trigger: grep finds no use of AttachedStickers outside its definition; the box uses AttachedSets.
effect: Two enums with the same stages and different method names; a reader may extend the unused one.
fix: Delete AttachedStickers (and give AttachedSets the matched answered/failed methods it has here).

title: api() caches only success; a missing or incompatible quillvideo library is re-searched and re-dlopen'd for every video sticker
trigger: Run a build where the quillvideo library exists but lacks the qs_* symbols (or fails to load), then scroll a chat with many video stickers
effect: Every decode_in_process call repeats candidates() is_file probes and library loads before falling back to ffmpeg; wasted work per sticker, no wrong result
fix: Cache the Result in a OnceLock<Result<&'static Api, String>> (a Loaded/Unavailable enum) so a failed lookup is remembered

title: OlderEnd::Asking(RequestId) is unused for forum topic pages; topic in-flight is found by purpose+topic scan of the request table
trigger: Forum topic older page: apply_topic_page/fail_topic_page never call ask_older/settle_older; topic_page_in_flight re-derives 'asking' from requests.ids_for_chat(purposes) filtered by forum_topic_id
effect: No bug today (drop_topic_pages_past forgets stale requests so late answers find no pending), but the stage lives in two places and fail_older() accepts any failure regardless of id
fix: Call ask_older(id) when the topic page is sent and settle_older(id) in apply_topic_page/fail_topic_page, like saved-messages and thread histories, and drop the purpose scan

title: StoryPageOps::begin at the 64-op cap evicts the oldest op even when none is finished, dropping an in-flight op
trigger: 64 story-page ops in flight at once (position() finds no finished op and falls back to index 0)
effect: The evicted request's answer finds no op, so its Checking/Sending status never settles into Succeeded/Failed and its toast is lost
fix: Refuse or queue the new op, or only evict finished ops

title: WebApps holds ten one-shot answer slots (open_result, write_access, emoji_access, data_sent, phone_share, custom_replies, found, attachment_menu_bot, attachment_menu_toggled) that forget_web_app_launches only partly clears
trigger: Leave an account while a mini-app send-data, write-access or emoji-access call is out; the answer lands after forget_web_app_launches
effect: The answer waits in the session until the account is live and the poll takes it; no window matches its RequestId so it is dropped. Bounded by the per-tick drain, so no visible bug
fix: One per-owner answer queue keyed by RequestId, cleared in a single forget method, or answers delivered straight to the window stage that holds the RequestId

title: ai_compose_apply_by_key overwrites an in-flight ApplyInPlace and sends a second AI request
trigger: Bind a style to the apply shortcut, type text, press the shortcut twice quickly (or once in the main window and once in a chat window) before the first answer arrives
effect: A second ai_apply_in_place request is sent (wasted AI quota, a flood limit can trip) and the first request's stage is dropped, so its answer never lands; in two windows the first window's result is silently lost
fix: Refuse (or ignore) the shortcut while apply_in_place is Some, or make it an enum Idle/Asked{request,..} where a new ask replaces only after cancelling; same-window repeat press is a no-op

title: AiComposeOpen::select_saved is a one-shot Option slot nothing clears if the saved style never shows up
trigger: Save a new style in the editor; the styles refresh never lists the name (renamed server side, refresh fails)
effect: select_saved stays Some until the box closes and re-checks style_names every frame; harmless today because the box owns it
fix: Fold into AiComposeView (Card { select_on_arrival: Option<String> }) or an enum with a way out when the style list answer lands without the name

title: TonWalletState keeps each fetched value beside a separate Fetch<()> stage
trigger: Open the Money page: own/state_fetch, rates/rates_fetch, explorer_url/explorer are written by different reducers
effect: No bug today (answers are matched by RequestId), but value and stage can disagree (own Some while state_fetch Failed after an update)
fix: Fetch<OwnWallet>, Fetch<Vec<(String,f64)>>, Fetch<String> so the value lives in Ready

title: EventLogPage::poll and ::typed are Option<Task> used as started flags; autoload is a one-shot Cell<Option<usize>>
trigger: Open Recent actions; the poll restarts only when page.poll.is_none() (event_log.rs, resume_event_log_poll), autoload is set and cleared by hand
effect: No bug today (page owns the tasks, tests cover wake/restart), but 'is the poll running' is answered by Option::is_none rather than a stage
fix: EventLogPoll::{Stopped, Running { _task }} and autoload folded into an EventLogLoad stage

title: baseline: DebugConfirm::{Closed, Asking{logs_on}} is a two-variant box flag (stage-enums-baseline unkeyed:DebugConfirm::Asking)
trigger: Toggle debug mode in Advanced; the confirm is a local yes/no, no request is out
effect: No bug: Asking holds only the bool being confirmed, closed by close(); listed so the register shows what is left in stage-enums-baseline
fix: Allow-list with the reason (a local confirm, no request) or move the bool into the box's own state

title: BackgroundAccounts::generation counter plus detached prepare tasks and PrepareSet worker counts stand in for held tasks
trigger: stop_background_accounts bumps generation; each in-flight prepare task (spawn_app(..).detach()) compares its captured generation, and PrepareSet::{Wanted,Cancelled}{workers} counts those detached tasks by hand
effect: no user-visible bug today; a prepare that outlives its generation is only ignored on landing, not cancelled
fix: Hold each prepare as a Task inside the Prepare stage (Preparing{task}) so cancel drops it; drop generation and the worker count

title: BotCreateDialog::version is a keystroke counter beside a detached debounce timer
trigger: type in the username field; each keystroke spawns spawn_screen(..).detach() timer and bumps version; the timer applies only if version is unchanged
effect: no bug today (stale timers fire and are ignored); the timer is not owned by the dialog so closing the box does not cancel it
fix: Replace with a Checking{timer: Task} stage replaced on each keystroke (as business/chatbots.rs LookupDebounce does)

title: SendToMenu::Reading is a bare in-flight variant whose read task is detached
trigger: open Settings > General on Windows; read_send_to_menu spawns a detached task and the answer is accepted by variant only
effect: no bug today (a single reader at a time)
fix: Reading{ _task: Task<()> } so leaving the stage cancels it

title: Restart after Unblock is lost when the unblock request is already in flight
trigger: blocked bot chat: Unblock from another entry (profile menu) then immediately press Restart before the first answers; set_chat_user_blocked returns Ok(None) so BotRestart::Unblocking is never set
effect: bot is unblocked but /start is never sent; user presses Restart again
fix: On Ok(None) with restart wanted, adopt the in-flight request id or queue the start

title: Verification code field is cleared as soon as the send is accepted, unlike the email and recovery fields
trigger: enter a wrong login code; submit_code clears code_input on Ok(request sent); the server then rejects it
effect: user retypes the whole code (email and recovery code fields keep the value until the step is done)
fix: Clear in sync_auth_forms when the step ends, like email_input

title: icon_svg does a filesystem metadata call for every bot on every render of the paperclip menu, and the global cache is never evicted
trigger: open the paperclip menu in a chat with N attachment bots; each frame stats N files
effect: wasted work while the menu is open; cache grows with every icon path seen
fix: Cache by file id in the session when the download lands

title: A lock-screen log out whose clients take more than 60 s to close ends Deferred and the run stays in LocalData::Wiping
trigger: press Log out on the lock screen with a large TDLib database that needs over CLOSE_GIVE_UP to close; the cap fires, done runs Deferred
effect: passcode already forgotten, local stays Wiping, no client starts for the rest of the run; user must restart Quill
fix: Make the wait unbounded for the wipe (or retry the close) instead of Deferred; or restore the passcode record when deferring

title: Active.chat is a bare i64 compared with the open chat id; account is not part of the key
trigger: autoscroll on in chat X of account A, switch to account B that has the same numeric chat id
effect: mode ends only through the account switch resetting history state; the loop itself cannot tell accounts apart
fix: Use ChatKey/AccountChat

title: Share phone number and Report spam confirm alerts act on a bare chat id with no screen epoch, unlike the join-requests alerts
trigger: open the contact bar's Share phone number (or Report spam) alert, then a notification click or shortcut switches the account on screen before OK is pressed; on_ok calls share_phone_number / report_chat + leave_channel with the old account's chat id on the new account's driver
effect: wrong target: a report and leave (or a phone share) is sent for whatever chat on the new account has that id, or an error note; join_requests.rs guards the same shape with screen_epoch/in_screen_scope
fix: Capture screen_epoch() and run through in_screen_scope as confirm_process_all_join_requests does

title: Appearance dialog build asks for icon and status downloads on every render
trigger: open Appearance of a channel while some emoji icon files fail to download; each dialog build calls download_background_emoji_icons and download_chat_status_choices which resend download_file for every sticker
effect: wasted work per frame while the dialog is open; relies on send_auto_download to refuse failed files
fix: Ask once when the dialog opens (open_chat_appearance), not from build

title: Pending cache entry has no failure arm: a tokenizer job that never lands leaves the block plain for the session
trigger: A pre block with a language is drawn; the detached background tokenize job panics or its app goes away before cache().finish runs
effect: The block stays plain until restart; lookup() sees Entry::Pending forever and never re-issues the Job, and Pending entries are not in the LRU order so they never evict
fix: Pending { job: Task<()> } held in the cache (dropped entry cancels), plus Failed so a failed job is retried or shown plain on purpose

title: Reply bar is cleared when the checklist send goes out, not when it is acknowledged; a refusal returns the dialog to editing but the reply is gone
trigger: Reply to a message, open Checklist, Create (send_checklist_draft Ok -> chat_ui.set_reply(None)); TDLib refuses (settle_checklist_dialog Answer::Failed puts the dialog back); user presses Create again
effect: The retried checklist is posted as a plain message, not as a reply to the original message (wrong target); nothing restores the reply
fix: Keep the reply in DialogSend::Sending{request, reply} and clear the bar on Answer::Done only, or restore it on Failed

title: BotThreadStart::Asked is never checked against the session: a lost new-thread request swallows every later Send in the All view
trigger: In a bot's All view press Send; createForumTopic is dropped without an answer (client reset, request dropped); press Send again
effect: send_waits_for_bot_thread sees Asked, only cx.notify(), returns true: the Send does nothing and shows no note until the chat or topic changes; advance_bot_thread waits for take_bot_thread_start(request) forever
fix: On each upkeep compare Asked.request with the session's in-flight set (waits_for) and fall back to Idle with a note, like Fetch::Loading

title: A refused rich send / inline pick gives its text back only to an empty field; if the user typed since, the text is dropped
trigger: Send a rich message (field cleared, draft forgotten); start typing the next message before TDLib answers; the send is refused (flood wait, lapsed Premium)
effect: apply_sent_text_answer takes SentText out and, with a non-empty field, neither restores nor saves it as a draft: the refused message text is lost (the LeftSend path saves a draft instead)
fix: On a refusal with a non-empty field, save the markup as the slot draft like settle_left_sends does, or keep it in the box

title: BoxStage Opening/Open (and CodeLanguageStage::Opening) is a focus-once flag renamed: a two-variant enum beside the box it belongs to
trigger: Open the Add Link box: stage is Opening until the first frame, then Open; nothing else reads it
effect: No bug today; the same one-shot 'focus after mount' is also an Option in ChecklistDialog::focus_on_mount and PollAddOption::take_focus, each hand-rolled
fix: One shared MountFocus { pending: Option<Entity<..>> } taken by the dialog on mount (focus_after_mount) instead of per-box stage enums

title: ClearStage::Spent waits for acks of messages that may never ack or fail, so the slot's DraftClear entry lives until a newer send replaces it (known leftover)
trigger: Send an album, delete one of its messages while it is still uploading (or TDLib refuses it without a failed update); the other messages ack
effect: Spent(messages) never reaches is_settled: the entry stays in ComposerSends::draft_clears for that slot (a bounded leak, one per slot); a later ack cannot clear another send's draft because take_draft_clear matches by message id or Unasked, so no wrong clear follows
fix: Drop the entry when the send's request is no longer in flight (answered request set in the stage), or when the temporary messages leave the history, instead of waiting for each message's ack

title: With Sync contacts off and a never-loaded list the Contacts tab reads Loading with nothing in flight, forever
trigger: Turn Sync contacts off, restart (users_state.contacts starts Fetch::Idle and nothing fetches it at login), open the Contacts tab: open_contacts_tab skips fetch_contacts because sync is off, then refetch_open_contacts calls refetch_invalidated_contacts, which returns unless the list is Outdated (Idle is not)
effect: contacts_list treats data().is_none() && !failed as Loading, so the tab shows Loading contacts... until Sync is switched back on (set_contact_sync fetches) or another screen asks for contacts; the comment in open_contacts_tab says such a list still loads
fields: Fetch::Idle for users_state.contacts and the draw rule loading = data().is_none() && !failed
fix: refetch_invalidated_contacts should also ask for an Idle list (can_ask) when the tab is open, and the tab should read a not-asked state (Idle) differently from Loading

title: Country box sends getCountries on every open, even when the list is loaded
trigger: Open the shipping/poll/card country box with the list already loaded
effect: A redundant getCountries request each open; the box has no loaded/failed gate
fix: Ask only when auth_state.countries is Idle/Failed (Fetch<T> already says which)

title: A queued link is taken from its slot before the send; a failed send drops it with no note
trigger: Click a t.me link while the driver send fails (native error) after auth Ready
effect: Nothing happens: no flow, no error note, link is gone
fix: Keep the link until the send returns a RequestId, or show an error note on Err

title: Join on the invite box takes invite_box before the send and ignores the send error
trigger: Press Join while confirm_deep_link_invite fails
effect: The box closes, no join and no error; the preview stays as session flow stage
fix: Close the box only on Ok(Some(request)); show the error otherwise

title: Linked media timestamp seek is an Option of (chat,message,seconds,Instant deadline) polled from upkeep
trigger: Open a t.me link with a media timestamp; the message loads late or never
effect: Deadline only evaluated when upkeep runs; the slot is session-wide with a bare ChatId, not owned by account/window
fix: A MediaSeek stage owned by the chat window holding a Task with the deadline, dropped with the chat

title: Device link stage is held twice: DeviceLink::Linking(RequestId) in privacy and DeviceLogin::Waiting{request} in the session
trigger: Link a device by QR; the request id is copied into the UI enum and the session's DeviceLogin
effect: No bug today; the UI Linking stage ends only when poll_device_qr takes the session result, so a result the session discards without answering leaves Linking (busy) until an account switch
fix: One owner: keep the Waiting request in DeviceLogin and let the UI read it (or hold only the UI enum and have the session keep an answer slot)

title: Auto-download limit is held twice: in AutoDownloadDraft and in the step slider state, kept in step by on_auto_download_slider
trigger: Open a source box; move a limit slider; open a chat picker and back
effect: No bug today: open seeds the slider from the draft and the slider callback writes the draft back, but close_picker/save_picker rebuild the box from the draft only, so the two copies agree only by the callback path
fix: Derive the slider position from the draft on render; keep one value

title: OptionAttach keeps a video preview frame beside the media slot; the two must change together
trigger: Attach a video to a poll option, then replace or clear the media
effect: No bug found: option_attach.rs clears preview on one path and sets it when the frame lands, but a clear that goes through media alone would leave a stale frame drawn
fix: Put the frame inside OptionMediaSlot::Ready (or Preparing) so it is dropped with the media

title: dismiss_keyboard_on_send is a one-shot Option on the poll box, set after open and consumed on send
trigger: Press a bot Poll button (one-time keyboard), cancel the box, press it again from another keyboard
effect: The slot lives and dies with the PollDialog so it self-clears; but it is written after open_poll_dialog_locked by the caller, so a failed open leaves nothing to hold it and the keyboard stays
fix: Pass the keyboard target into PollDialog::new (QuizLock-style argument)

title: The withdrawal's 2FA password is copied into a plain String and only dropped, not zeroized
trigger: Submit the Stars/TON withdrawal password box
effect: The cloud password stays in freed heap memory; the rest of the code (callback password, device link) uses Zeroizing or the A2 rule
fix: Read the value into Zeroizing<String> (or pass the input's text without copying) before submit_withdrawal_password

title: Edit Cover's file dialog task is detached and its answer is matched by the edited (chat, message) pair
trigger: Edit message A, press Edit Cover, leave the dialog open, cancel the edit and start a new edit of the same message A
effect: The old dialog's pick lands on the new edit of the same message: the cover is staged for an edit the person never asked it for
fix: Hold the picker Task in the edit's media_edit (a CoverPick stage) so ending or restarting the edit drops it

title: Retry on a failed older/newer page drops the send result
trigger: History page fails to load, press Retry while the driver refuses the send
effect: The strip stays and nothing says the retry did not go out
fix: On Err set a status note (as retry_history_load does)

title: Create/Schedule pressed while a createVideoChat is out closes the box and sends nothing, with no note
trigger: Press Create, then open Start video chat again and press Create before the first answer
effect: The box closes and nothing happens
fix: Keep the box open (disabled) while VideoChatCreate::Sent, or say a create is in progress

title: Start Streaming while a createVideoChat is out resets only the box view; the RTMP process and its box stay
trigger: Press Start Streaming while a create is out
effect: The box stays open with no reaction
fix: Close the RTMP process (close_rtmp_start) or disable the button while a create is out

title: SetsView.tab shadows the session's EmojiPanel.tab (Installed/Trending/Search) and is kept in step by hand
trigger: Open the emoji packs box, type a query (panel.tab=Search, view.tab=Installed), clear the field: the view tab decides which tab to go back to; select_emoji_sets_tab and show_emoji_sets_tab each write one of the two
effect: No wrong output today; a path that sets one tab without the other would show the highlighted tab and the list out of step
fix: One tab value in the panel with a separate Search { return_to } variant

title: event_log_ids (Cell<Vec<i64>>) mirrors the ListState item count and must be reset together with it
trigger: Any path that calls event_log_list.reset/splice without writing event_log_ids (or the reverse) leaves the plan_sync diff against rows that are not in the list
effect: List rows out of step with the entries (wrong or missing rows) until the next reset
fix: Keep the shown ids inside one owner that wraps the ListState and only changes through sync()

title: Reopening Share Folder while a link delete is still out asks for the list without waiting for the delete, so the deleted link comes back
trigger: In Share Folder press Delete on a link and confirm (LinkOp::Saving(request)), Done/close the box at once (close_folder_share hands the request to closed_asks as LinkChange), reopen Share Folder: open_folder_share -> driver.fetch_folder_share(folder_id), which (connect/folder_links.rs fetch_folder_share) only checks links.is_loading(), not a DeleteChatFolderInviteLink in flight; getChatFolderInviteLinks can be read before the delete lands. refetch_outdated_folder_links only runs when links.is_outdated() (a list that was loading when the delete was sent), and settle_closed_folder_asks LinkChange arm does nothing on success
effect: The deleted invite link is listed again (with copy/edit) until the box is reopened after the delete has landed; deleting it again errors
fix: fetch_folder_share waits for (or is re-sent on the answer of) the in-flight DeleteChatFolderInviteLink of that folder; the LinkChange ask refetches the list on success

title: A second addlist link opened while an add is out is dropped: the old box is shown and the new link is never checked
trigger: Add a shared folder (InviteStage::Adding), click another t.me/addlist link before the answer
effect: Box for the first folder re-raised; the second link silently ignored (comment says it waits, nothing remembers it)
fix: Keep the next link in the Adding stage (Adding { request, info, next }) and check it when the add settles, or say it was ignored

title: EventLogPage.poll Option<Task> is a running/stopped flag: the loop ends by itself (page closed, dialog left) and leaves Some(finished task)
trigger: Open Recent Actions (poll Some), close Group Settings: event_log_poll_tick sees event_log_open_chat() None, returns false and the task ends, but page.poll stays Some. Only the window-inactive path writes None, and resume_event_log_poll reads is_none() as 'stopped'. Today every entry into RecentActions calls start_event_log_poll (group_admin_settings.rs set_group_settings_view), which replaces it, so no stuck poll follows
effect: No wrong output today; a path that reaches the page without set_group_settings_view would see a dead poll treated as running
fix: enum PollStage { Stopped, Running(Task<()>) } that the loop's own exit sets to Stopped

title: Cancel in the Recent Actions filter box re-asks the whole log and restarts the poll
trigger: Recent Actions open, press Filter, press Cancel: close_event_log_filter -> set_group_settings_view(RecentActions), which runs start_event_log_poll, hook_event_log_scroll and driver.fetch_chat_event_log again for the same chat
effect: The list falls back to Loading and the reader loses their scroll place for a filter they did not change
fix: Entering a page the dialog already shows (RecentActions after its own RecentActionsFilter) only changes the view; the ask and poll start belong to the first open

title: CraftStage::Forging { request } in the UI and CraftSession.run (Crafting { request }) in the session are two stage holders for one craft, kept in step by hand
trigger: craft_now writes session craft.run (demo) / driver and then CraftStage::start_forge; craft_frame_upkeep compares craft.run == Crafting{request} and calls end_forge; after_craft_pop clears both separately (gift_market.craft = Idle and market.craft = None)
effect: No bug today; an exit that clears one and not the other leaves the forge box without its craft, or a craft with no forge to end
fix: One owner of the craft stage (the session's CraftRun), with the forge start time as its own variant data

title: GifTab::Asked is never left by itself: a window whose ask ended but whose list the session replaced stays Asked and shows Missing until a press
trigger: Open the GIF tab in a chat window (Wants -> Asking -> Asked), then search in the main window so the session's one GIF list holds another query and searches_kept lacks this window's; gif_tab_upkeep only asks from Wants, and follow_gif_wanted only runs for the window the user pressed in
effect: The non-pressed window's GIF tab can show an empty body (GifShown::Missing, no status text) until the user presses in it
fix: Asked leaves to Wants when gif_shown() is Missing and nothing is on its way, with the retry bounded by the request outcome

title: CallBox::Share carries two bare bools (speaker, copied) edited by hand from set_share_speaker/mark_share_copied
trigger: Open Share Invite Link, copy, tick 'can speak'
effect: none today; 'copied' is a transient stage held as a bool that set_share_speaker resets by hand
fix: Share { link_kind: LinkKind, copied: Option<LinkKind> } or a small ShareStage enum so the 'copied' notice is tied to the link it copied

title: GroupCallScreen::composer_call and the composer's text are two things kept in step by hand
trigger: Type in the in-call composer, then the tracked call changes while the call window is closed
effect: none today: sync_group_call_composer clears the text on the next call-window frame; a closed window keeps the old text and the old composer_call until then
fix: hold the draft as Option<(CallId, text)> in CallView (replaced whole in sync_group_call_boxes) instead of a screen-wide composer entity plus a call stamp

title: SaveStage::Saving reads its failure from the bounded failure registry at every call, unlike Exiting which is settled into Refused
trigger: Save sends a toggle edit (signatures/auto-translate/history) that TDLib refuses; 64+ other refusals are recorded before the box next derives its state
effect: the registry forgets the refusal, state() returns Saved and the box closes as if saved, dropping the typed edits and the reason
fix: settle_group_edit_box converts a failed Saving request into SaveStage::Refused(reason) exactly as it already does for Exiting

title: StreamPhoto::Blurred { image: None } folds a failed blur into the loaded stage, so a failure is never asked again for the same path
trigger: Open a live stream window for a channel whose photo file cannot be read when it is first blurred (file mid-write)
effect: the blurred backdrop stays missing (initials/plain background) until the chat's photo path changes or the window reopens; group_call_stream_photo matches the cached path and returns the empty image
fix: StreamPhoto::Failed { path } as its own variant, retried on a later path or reopen, instead of Blurred with an Option image

title: send_group_call_join mutes the session's self-mute mark before the join is sent and does not put it back when the send fails
trigger: Push-to-talk on, press Join while the connection refuses the join (join_video_chat returns Err), then turn push-to-talk off
effect: the tracked call keeps is_muted_self = true from the failed attempt; the mute button shows muted before any join and the next join starts muted although push-to-talk is off
fix: set the mute mark only when join_video_chat returns Ok (or send it as part of the join request) so a refused join changes nothing

title: Marketplace box: UI draft chat and session gift chat are two copies reset by hand
trigger: Open Buy-by-name for chat A, load a gift, close; open for chat B
effect: No bug today: open_marketplace_for clears the name/comment inputs and sets session.payments.marketplace_gift = None by hand in step with MarketplaceBox::open_for; a missed path would show A's quote in B's box
fix: One owner: put the draft chat, inputs reset and the GiftPurchase in one value replaced whole on open (GiftPurchase carries the privacy/error too)

title: Sticker category fetch is re-sent from render after a failed send; the Fetch never reaches Failed
trigger: Open the sticker tab while the TDLib sender is gone (send_json returns Err); sticker_category_strip sees sticker_categories.is_idle() every frame
effect: fetch_sticker_categories -> sticker_request fails, take()s the request and calls lists.for_purpose(GetStickerCategories), which is None, so sticker_categories stays Idle and is never marked Failed; every render defers another failing send and the category strip never shows or reports an error
fix: On a failed send call sticker_categories.failed(..) (add GetStickerCategories to the failing-send path), and have the strip only ask when the Fetch is Idle and never re-ask from Failed

title: Closing the gift code box while Use Link is applying drops the stage and its answer
trigger: Open a giftcode link, press Use Link, press Close (Close stays enabled while Applying) before the answer
effect: close_gift_code_box sets payments.gift_code = None, so the Applying { request } stage and its owner are gone; the applyPremiumGiftCode answer or error finds no lookup and shows nothing (a failure such as 'already used' is never reported, success is silent). open_gift_code_link while applying also ignores the new link with only a comment saying it waits
fix: Close during Applying keeps the stage (box hidden, answer shown as a note) or disables Close until the request answers; queue the second link or say it was ignored

title: Viewer caption stage (expanded/docked) is reset from render when the plate key differs
trigger: Expand a caption, step to an item with no caption (plate not drawn), step back
effect: ViewerCaption::reset runs only inside viewer_caption_plate, so a stage can survive an item that never drew a plate and the earlier item comes back already expanded or docked open
fix: Reset ViewerExtra::caption in reset_viewer_item_state (the item's own transition) and drop the key

title: Media panel mode, tab, key, category and active_section are reset together by hand at four sites
trigger: Any path that changes mode or tab without going through enter_selector_mode / set_media_panel_tab / open_media_panel / choose_sticker_category
effect: No bug found today; each writer repeats key = None, category = None, active_section = 0 (and the GIF gate sync), so a new writer that misses one shows rows or a category of the previous mode
fix: One PanelView value (mode + tab + category + section) replaced whole by the one writer set_media_panel_mode

title: Language file writes are ordered by hand-kept sequence counters on detached tasks
trigger: Switch language A then B quickly, or quit right after a switch
effect: LanguageWrites.issued/written are u64 counters in a Mutex standing in for task ownership; each write is a detached background_spawn, so a write cannot be cancelled or awaited at quit and a lost write leaves the previous choice on disk
fix: One Task<()> per LanguageFile held in LanguageUi (replacing the old drops it), or a single writer queue flushed on quit

title: Copy photo clipboard write is a detached task that outlives the viewer item
trigger: Press Copy on a large photo, then step to another item or close the viewer before the encode ends
effect: The finished PNG still lands on the clipboard and the 'Photo copied' note shows for an item the user has left; the task is not held by any stage
fix: Hold the encode in a stage on the viewer item (cancelled by reset_viewer_item_state) like reorient

title: Scope/reaction notification toggles send a copy of the cached settings; two quick changes overwrite each other
trigger: In Notifications defaults, flip two switches of one scope (or reaction section) within one round trip, e.g. mentions off then pinned off
effect: The second setScopeNotificationSettings carries the first field's old value (cache not yet updated by updateScopeNotificationSettings), so the first change is reverted by the server and the switch springs back
fix: Send a patch of the one field, or hold an in-flight stage per scope/section (Fetch-like Saving { request }) and disable the section until the answer

title: baseline: show_notification_with_preview is a detached 100 ms poll loop with a u64 id counter (preview_waits)
trigger: A photo message notification waits for its download (up to 3 s)
effect: Nothing visible; the wait cannot be cancelled by its owner, it polls on a bare timer and a counter tells old waits from new ones
fix: preview_waits: HashMap<Key, PreviewWait { file, deadline, _task: Task<()> }> woken by the file update; replacing or removing the entry drops the task, no counter

title: baseline: ensure_notify_clock polls on a timer loop (owned-timers baseline poll)
trigger: Any notification window is up
effect: Wakes every 16 ms while animating and every INPUT_CHECK_MS while a window waits for input; stops itself when no window is left (Clock::Stopped)
fix: Keep: Clock is an enum holding the Task; move to frame clock / idle-event wake instead of a timer loop, or add to owned-timers-allow with that reason

title: Mute panel, TTL picker and folder menu are three Options kept exclusive by hand
trigger: open_mute_menu sets notify.ttl_picker = None and folders.menu_chat = None; open_ttl_picker calls close_mute_menu and clears folders.menu_chat
effect: No bug today; a fourth chat-settings box has to remember to clear all the others, else two boxes target one chat
fix: One ChatSettingsBox enum { None, Mute(MuteBox), Ttl(ChatId), Folders(ChatId) } on the screen

title: baseline: PasscodeJob::Running is a bare in-flight variant; the job's answer is matched by taking the stage, not by an id
trigger: Any PBKDF2 passcode job (Create, Change, Turn off, unlock) or a system-unlock wait
effect: No bug today: every starter checks is_running first and Cancelled counts as running. A starter added without that check would overwrite Running/RunningThenLock and the first answer would clear the second job's stage
fix: Running { request: JobId, _task: Task<()> } with the answer compared to the held id; RunningThenLock/Cancelled as flags of that stage

title: baseline: spawn_passcode_tick is a detached auto-lock watcher
trigger: App start; runs for the life of the process, also while locked, hidden or logged out
effect: Sleeps on sleep_or_wake with a 300 s net, then ticks each second during a flood countdown; nothing can cancel it
fix: Hold the Task in PasscodeUi (AutoLock { _task }) so the lock owner drops it; or add to owned-timers-allow

title: System-unlock wait polls a channel every 100 ms with no way out; while the OS prompt is unanswered the passcode field is refused
trigger: Lock with system unlock on; the next frame offers the prompt (LockScreen::OfferSystemUnlock) and the prompt is ignored, hidden behind another window, or never answers on this platform
effect: PasscodeJob stays Running, so submit_unlock returns early and the Unlock button is disabled and spinning; the user cannot type the passcode until the OS prompt is dismissed. Also the detached 100 ms timer loop (owned-timers baseline detached+poll) keeps running
fix: A Cancel path: typing in the field or the Unlock press while SystemPrompt{_task} is out cancels it (job -> Idle, receiver dropped); wait on a channel wake instead of a timer poll

title: baseline: sync_qr_clock runs a 1 s timer loop
trigger: The QR box shows a countdown (temporary contact link or free code)
effect: One wake per second while a countdown shows; the Task is held in OpenQr.clock (Option<Task>) and dropped with the box or by the tick; the lock clears it. Option<Task> doubles as a started flag
fix: enum Clock { Stopped, Running { _task } } as notify_windows::hold::Clock does; wake on the countdown deadline

title: baseline: Slot::Loading is bare in peer_qr/art.rs and gift_art.rs (2 hits)
trigger: A backdrop, code, emoji still, gift still or tile is being made off the UI thread
effect: The slot holds no task or id. If the off-UI job's window goes away before it lands the slot stays Loading for the rest of the box, and a failed spawn is never retried until the box closes (Art::clear)
fix: Slot::Loading { _job: Task<()> } (run_off_ui_held) so dropping the slot cancels and a re-ask restarts

title: baseline: ApplyStage::Sent is a bare stage in the Your color box
trigger: Apply answered by all requests
effect: Sent holds nothing and leaves only on an edit; no bug (Applying holds Vec<RequestId> and settle matches by id)
fix: Keep; fold Sent into Editing { applied: bool } or allow-list with the reason

title: baseline: sign-in busy is read as requests.has_auth_submit() (matched by purpose)
trigger: Any auth submit in flight, from any window
effect: The sign-in cards show Working for another window's or an older submit; a lost answer leaves the button busy until the request table drops it
fix: AuthUi holds Submitting { request } and compares waits_for(id)

title: baseline: TitleCheck::Sent(String) names a sent create by its text, not its RequestId
trigger: Create pressed with a title; TDLib refuses NO_CHAT_TITLE
effect: The error shows only while the field still holds the sent text; the create's real request lives in NewChatStage::Creating, so the two can disagree (e.g. stage left Creating, check stays Sent)
fix: Put the sent title in NewChatStage::Creating { request, title } and derive the error from it

title: CardInput::presses u64 counter stands in for the effect cycle of a Backspace/Delete snapshot
trigger: Backspace or Delete in a card field; a double defer clears the snapshot unless a newer press replaced it
effect: No bug found; the counter and DeleteEdit::Snapshot { press } are a hand-made generation check beside the DeleteEdit enum
fix: Make the snapshot's clear a Task held in DeleteEdit::Snapshot { _clear: Task<()> } so a newer press drops the older clear; no counter

title: Create in the New Contact box does nothing when the driver refuses to send (Ok(None))
trigger: Window > Add Contact, fill the fields, press Create while the driver declines the import without an error (no connection)
effect: Stage stays Form; no note, no spinner, the button seems dead
fix: Treat Ok(None) from a live driver as a refusal: set an error note, as the Err arm does

title: PolledRedraw keeps owed redraws as two bools beside a RedrawNeed
trigger: Every poll step records a RedrawNeed
effect: No bug (tests cover held-back redraws); full: RedrawNeed, list: bool and conversation: bool are three owed-slots updated together in record/decide/drawn
fix: One Owed { full: Option<Urgency>, list: Option<Instant>, conversation: bool } or a bitset type with one clear()

title: PremiumAutoStart.request uses RequestId(0) as a 'no request' sentinel
trigger: Subscribe pressed with no driver or no deep-link stage: auto_start is stored with RequestId(0)
effect: nothing today (demo only); the stored /start can never be dropped by an error answer and waits for a later visit to the bot
fix: auto_start holds Some(RequestId) only when a resolve went out; no auto_start otherwise

title: EditProfileDialog keeps two parallel in-flight stages (op: SectionOp and save: Submit)
trigger: Save pressed while a username/photo op is Sending, or a username op started while the form save is Sending
effect: each stage settles on its own request and shows its own error; begin_profile_op forgets the earlier op's ack without telling the form
fix: one DialogOp enum (Idle | Section(RequestId) | Saving(Vec<RequestId>))

title: Voice/video note send registers its draft clear under the open chat's slot, not the target chat's, overwriting that slot's own clear
trigger: Tap Send on a voice note in chat A with a caption, open chat B at once, and send a text in B before A's encode ends: send_finished_voice calls expect_draft_clear, which inserts into B's slot (set_draft_clear replaces the entry); with no chat open the clear is dropped
effect: B's text draft is not cleared on its ack and comes back as a draft (or A's caption draft reappears when no chat was open): the same text can be sent twice
fix: expect_draft_clear takes the SendSlot the send was fixed on (SendTarget holds the slot), never send_slot() at landing

title: Same wrong-slot draft clear for the finished round video
trigger: Tap Send on a round video, switch chats before ffmpeg finishes the file
effect: the open chat's pending clear is replaced by the video's; a clear can be dropped when no chat is open
fix: SendTarget carries its SendSlot; set_draft_clear(target slot, ...)

title: DiscardRow {Hidden, Confirming}, Delivery {Normal, PlayOnce} and RecordMode {Held, Locked} are bools renamed to two-variant enums
trigger: Press Cancel on the record bar (Confirming), then Lock or Play once
effect: no bug today: each is a user toggle held with the Capture so it dies with the recording; DiscardRow is the confirm-row stage flag in disguise and is set to Hidden by hand from three places (keep, cancel, take)
fix: one RecordBar stage enum (Recording | ConfirmingDiscard) beside two settings

title: Picker, clipboard and decode answers for the photo sources are matched by PhotoTarget (chat id), not by a held stage or request
trigger: Open the group Edit box, choose Photo or video, close and reopen the Edit box of the same chat before the file decodes
effect: the old pick lands in the new box of the same chat (photo_target() == target holds); harmless for the user's own pick, wrong if they cancelled
fix: hold the pick's Task in the sources stage (as CameraStage::Starting does) so closing the box drops it

title: PollVotersDialog is two modes (voters / stats) kept as show_stats: bool beside selected_option: Option<usize>
trigger: Open Poll Stats, then close and open the voters list for the same message
effect: no bug today: title and body read the bool, selected_option is None until an option is picked so 'selected nothing' and 'not yet asked' are the same value
fix: enum PollView { Voters{option}, Stats{option} }

title: PullUi target, machine and slide are reset together by hand (restart at 4 sites, slide=None at 3)
trigger: Pull to the next channel, window closes or chat changes mid-jump
effect: the stages are cleared by pull_sync/pull_jump_ended/pull_slide_offset separately; a missed site leaves a slide pointing at a chat no longer shown (cleared on the next frame today)
fix: put slide inside the machine's Jumping stage so reset_all drops it

title: A photo check that lands after its 15s give-up leaves its JPEG on disk
trigger: Attach a large HEIC/JXL photo whose decode takes over 15 seconds; the give-up timer settles the read as FileOnly, then the worker finishes and writes a JPEG into quill-send-photos.
effect: finish_media_check returns early on the stale job and drops MediaCheck::Jpeg(path) without removing the file, so each late result leaves a temp JPEG until the scratch dir is cleaned.
fix: Remove the Jpeg file when finish() reports a stale job (as video_preview does), or have the stage own the file.

title: Hovering a gallery row re-asks for its menu actions on every hover until an answer lands
trigger: Move the pointer on and off a Files/Media row several times before the first getMessageProperties answer arrives, or on a row whose answer never comes (message deleted).
effect: Each hover-in with no cached actions sends another getMessageProperties; nothing records that one is in flight, so a row whose answer never lands asks again on every hover.
fix: Hold a Fetch<MessageActions> per (chat, message) so a hover asks only while Idle.

title: Change-password form with an empty new password turns two-step verification off
trigger: Settings > Privacy > Two-step verification > Change password: type the current password, leave New password empty, press Change. submit_twofa_password(include_email=false) only requires the current password; set_two_step_password maps an empty new password to PasswordOp::DisablePassword.
effect: The account's cloud password is removed although the user asked to change it; the view returns to Status showing it Off and the typed current password is cleared. No confirmation or error.
