fix: Make the form a TwofaForm enum (Enable/Change/Disable/Email) whose Change variant requires a non-empty new password, and let only Disable send an empty one.

title: Two-step forms share their input entities, so Turn off can send a hidden new password
trigger: Open the Change form, type a current and a new password, press Back, open Turn off, retype only the current password, press Turn off. goto_twofa_view only clears the flow notice; new_password, hint and email entities keep their text and are read by the same submit_twofa_password.
effect: Turn off sends setPassword with the stale hidden new password and hint, so the cloud password is changed to a value the user cannot see instead of being removed. Email and Recover forms leak the same way.
fix: A TwofaForm enum whose variant owns its own inputs (built on entering the view and dropped on leaving), so a form can only read the fields it shows.

title: Selection owner table is cleared at 50,000 entries, mid-selection, and never pruned otherwise
trigger: Scroll a very long history so more than 50,000 text handles have painted (each new row makes a new TextSelectionHandle), with a drag selection under way.
effect: OWNERS (entity id to bare (chat, message)) is a thread-local with no owner: it is only cleared wholesale. After the clear the anchor's message is unknown, so rows of other messages stop being treated as foreign and one copy can join text of several messages; the entries are also bare chat ids, not account keys.
fix: Keep the message key in the text handle's own element state, or in a map owned by the WindowSlot that drops entries with their rows.

title: SettingsSearch::stage Finished is a one-shot reset marker that only the next render consumes
trigger: close_settings() sets stage = Finished; settle_settings_search (run from settings_window render) is the only reader and turns it back into Live by clearing the input.
effect: No bug today: the next open renders and settles before the field is read. The enum is a two-state flag beside the input text it stands for, set from outside its own transitions.
fix: Have close_settings() clear the input directly (it has no Window, so queue a Farewell step), and make stage just the selected row.

title: Send box tile buttons act on a tray index, not on the attachment they were drawn for
trigger: Press Remove, Spoiler or Edit on a tile in one window while another window of the same chat removes or adds an attachment between that frame and the click.
effect: remove_attachment(index), toggle_attachment_spoiler(index) and edit_send_card_item(index) read the current tray at click time, so a shifted index acts on the neighbouring file. (pick_attachment_cover already uses a TrayItem.)
fix: Key every tile action by TrayItem (slot plus path), as pick_attachment_cover does.

title: SpellUi::engine_task is an Option<Task> used as the 'engine build in flight' stage, cleared by hand in install_spell_engine
trigger: Pick a spelling language twice quickly in Appearance > Spelling: the second start_spell_engine drops the first task by overwrite; install clears the Option by hand
effect: None today (the task is dropped with the overwrite and install resets it); the stage is an Option kept in step with spell.info rather than one value
fix: enum EngineBuild { Idle, Building { chosen, _task } } owned by SpellUi, replaced whole on each start and on install

title: Media spoiler TileState::Building has no way out if the background build never answers
trigger: build_image_tile panics or the spawned task is cancelled with the app still alive: TILE stays Building
effect: Media spoiler specks never draw again for the session (cover still shows); text spoilers unaffected
fix: Building holds the task and a failure arm returns to Idle (or Failed) so the next frame can ask again

title: baseline: PickWait::Downloading holds a FileId and window but no request or task; the wait is ended by polling the download tracker each frame
trigger: Adapt/Add an existing sticker or GIF that is not downloaded: ask_pick_file sends downloadFile, the stage waits; sticker_box_window_upkeep polls local_media_path / ended_without_file in the host window's frame
effect: Works today (a failed download ends the wait with a note, a closed box or window ends it); a host window that never draws a frame (minimized chat window) leaves the wait until it draws
fix: Downloading { request: RequestId, .. } answered by the download ack, not polled from upkeep

title: SidebarReveal::wake (the grace-period redraw task) is a parallel field beside Mode, kept in step by set_mode, instead of living in Peek::Leaving
trigger: Pointer leaves the peeking sidebar: pointer_left sets Mode::Hidden(Leaving) and the caller then spawns the wake and hands it to hold_wake, which silently drops it if the mode is no longer Leaving
effect: None today (every set_mode resets the wake); a new transition that assigns self.mode directly would leave a stale wake or lose one
fix: Peek::Leaving { since, wake: Task<()> } so the task is dropped with the stage

title: ChartState::key_point and ChartState::pie are two Options that exclude each other by hand
trigger: Arrow keys pick a point (key_point), then a click zooms into the pie: enter_pie clears key_point by hand; step() and the key handler stay out of the pie only through `!pie` guards in the view
effect: None today; a new entry into the pie (or a step while in it) that forgets the other field would show a key readout over a pie
fix: enum ChartFocus { Plot, Point(usize), Pie(PieZoom) }

title: The story viewer's 100 ms tick redraws the overlay for as long as the viewer is open, also while paused, behind a panel or with the window inactive
trigger: Open a story, press Space (or switch to another app): ensure_story_tick keeps waking every 100 ms; story_playback_paused only gates playback, notify_story(cx) runs every wake
effect: 10 redraws a second of an overlay that shows nothing new (battery/CPU), until the viewer is closed
fix: Stop the tick (StoryTick::Off) while paused or inactive and start it on resume, or notify only when something on the overlay changed

title: A new download of a code can start while the cancelled worker of the same code is still running, both writing the same .{code}.{ext}.part temp files
trigger: Switch a downloading language off (Cancelling, worker past its last cancel check and inside spell_catalog::install), then switch it on again at once: start_dictionary_download only refuses Running, and install uses fixed temp names
effect: One of the two installs fails its rename ("Couldn't save the dictionary") or the files are interleaved; the list refreshes from disk afterwards
fix: Refuse (or queue) a new download while Cancelling, or give install a unique temp name per call

title: Export to File has no stage: pressing it twice before the save dialog answers opens two dialogs and writes two files
trigger: Click "Export to File" twice quickly on a statistics page; each press snapshots the sheets and spawns its own detached task awaiting prompt_for_new_path
effect: Two save dialogs in a row; a second toast overwrites the first
fix: enum Export { Idle, Choosing { _task } } on the statistics page state, held and dropped with the panel

title: ToastQueue keeps the footer `note` and the `showing`/`waiting` toasts as two copies of one note, reconciled by hand in advance()
trigger: set_note_in stores the note in `note` and pushes it into `showing`/`waiting`; clear_note, drop_toasts and advance each reset one half to match the other
effect: none today; a new path that sets one half only would leave a footer note with no toast or a toast with no note
fix: one enum per note: Footer(note) | Toast{note,timer} so the toast stage owns the note

title: Order::Reordering(keys) waits for the model to echo a pinned-chat reorder but holds no request and has no timeout
trigger: drag a pin on the Touch Bar so Command::ReorderPinned is sent (driver returns Ok(Some)); TDLib then rejects the reorder asynchronously (offline, flood wait, chat unpinned elsewhere)
effect: dropped_order_holds keeps returning the local dropped order while the model has the same pins in another order (Echo::Waiting), so the Touch Bar shows an order the server does not have until the pin set itself changes; only a synchronous Err calls reorder_refused
fix: Reordering { request: RequestId } settled by the driver's answer (ok -> Model, error -> Model + reorder_refused)

title: Touch Bar viewer slider seeks on every continuous slider event, while the audio slider waits for `done`
trigger: drag the Touch Bar seek slider while a video is open in the media viewer
effect: a seek request per slider event (up to tens per second) instead of one on release; wasted decoder work and stutter
fix: ViewerSeek { fraction, done } like PlayerSeek, seek only on done

title: baseline: EditorStage::Reading/Encoding carry a `serial: u64` counter next to the Task that already cancels a replaced stage
trigger: open the video editor, or press Done; the answer is matched by `is_reading(serial)` / `is_encoding(serial)` through next_editor_serial()
effect: none today; the held Task is dropped when the stage changes, so the counter only guards a closure that cannot run any more
fix: drop the serial; the stage holding the Task is the identity (or hold a RequestId for the probe/encode job)

title: open_video_editor overwrites an open VideoEditorDialog without releasing its cover frame temp file
trigger: an editor is open with a cut cover (CoverFrame.path in the temp dir) and another open_video_editor call replaces send_box.video_editor (e.g. a tray item and a sticker editor opened in turn from different windows)
effect: the old CoverFrame png stays in quill-video-edits until the scratch sweep; only close_video_editor removes it
fix: replace through one close-then-open transition (take the old editor and delete its cover)

title: baseline: start_update_checks is a detached 4 h loop; download_update keeps a 250 ms redraw loop; spawn_open_poll polls every 50 ms
trigger: app start (update checks), a running update download, any VideoPlayer in Opening
effect: the 4 h loop is never cancelled and keeps asking while the app is locked or the account is logged out; the other two are held by their stage/player and end with it
fix: hold the re-check Task in UpdateState (Idle { next_check: Task }) and wake on the download progress signal instead of a 250 ms poll

title: ViewerUi::open_gen is a bare u64 bumped by hand at six sites and compared by PendingGallery.viewer_opens to tell which viewer open it asked for
trigger: press a profile photo (wait_for_profile_gallery stamps open_gen), open another viewer item or close it before the gallery lands
effect: none today; every new open path must remember `open_gen += 1` or a late gallery opens over the wrong viewer
fix: the viewer's open is one value (MediaViewer::Open{id}) and the pending gallery holds that id, or a RequestId for the gallery fetch

title: StoryOpen::Waiting holds the PendingStoryOpen but no RequestId or Task; resolve_pending_story_open polls story_fetch by (chat, story) from upkeep
trigger: press a story, a repost label or a story link while the story is not cached
effect: works today because get_story marks a failed send; the wait is matched by chat+story key, not by the getStory request, so a second press of the same story shares one answer
fix: Waiting { open, request: RequestId } settled by that request's answer or error

title: baseline: current() uses RefCell::borrow() on the thread-local CURRENT
trigger: scope() runs a build closure that re-enters current() while replace() is mid-call (not reachable today: replace is a single statement)
effect: a BorrowError panic would take the window down; no path found
fix: try_borrow with a None fallback, as the rest of the file does

title: A strip frame that failed to render (StripFrame::Failed) is kept as done; video_editor_reload_frames only recuts when the frame count or strip width changes
trigger: open the video editor on a clip where ffmpeg fails for one timestamp
effect: a blank cell in the timeline strip until the dialog is resized or reopened
fix: Failed cells keep their time and are asked again once, or the strip shows the last good frame

title: pump_translation retries Translation::Failed messages only when the chat is reopened (scan removed from the pump map)
trigger: translate a chat while offline or after a flood wait so some messages fail, then go back online with the chat still open
effect: the failed messages stay untranslated until the chat is closed and opened again
fix: a per-message Failed { at } that the pump retries after a backoff, instead of a reopen

title: AccessStage::Asking is a bare flag: the popup answer is matched by PopupPurpose::EmojiStatusAccess, not by an id held in the stage
trigger: A mini app asks for emoji status access; the popup is shown and PopupClosed is routed by purpose via window.popups[id]
effect: No bug today (one popup at a time, replaced popups are answered as dismissed), but the stage cannot tell its own popup from another
fix: Asking { popup: PopupId } checked when the PopupClosed arrives, and the popups map keyed by that id

title: SetStage::Resolving { request: Option<RequestId> } uses the Option as a 'lookup sent yet' flag; resolve_suggested_emoji re-sends from the poll tick while it is None
trigger: web_app_set_emoji_status while the shared custom-emoji lookup is busy
effect: The poll re-asks every 250 ms tick until the lookup goes out or 15 s pass; no stuck state, but two stages are folded in one
fix: Queued / Asked { request } as two variants

title: WriteAccess::Asking is a bare variant: the consent popup answer is matched by PopupPurpose::WriteAccess
trigger: A mini app requests write access and the bot needs consent
effect: No bug today; the answer is routed by purpose, not by the popup the stage opened
fix: Asking { popup: PopupId }

title: baseline: PhoneFlow::Asking is a bare in-flight variant (stage-enums baseline); the answer is matched by PopupPurpose::Phone
trigger: web_app_request_phone
effect: No bug today
fix: Asking { popup: PopupId }

title: LaunchFlow::Searching/FetchingAttachBot/Adding have no way out when their request is dropped without an answer
trigger: Open a named app link (t.me/bot/app), then the request is dropped by the stale sweep or a reconnect; no found/attachment answer is ever pushed
effect: flow.is_waiting() stays true so poll_mini_apps never ends and the mini-app poll keeps waking at the 5 s ceiling for the rest of the session (also while hidden/locked); the launch silently never happens. Only a newer launch replaces it. emoji_status.rs handles exactly this dropped case for its Granting stage; the flow does not
effect_note: worst case wasted wakeups and a dead tap
fix: Check session.requests.get(awaited.request) in poll_mini_apps and end the stage with an error note when it left flight

title: MiniApps::generation is a counter that tells old poll wake-ups from the current one while the poll Task is already held in MiniApps::poll
trigger: ensure_mini_app_poll after the poll ended
effect: No bug today; a second source of truth beside the held Task (round-3 'counter' shape)
fix: Drop generation; the held Task is cancelled when poll is replaced or cleared

title: Poll::Asking(request) never leaves flight if TDLib drops the poll request without a PublicData answer
trigger: A watching widget polls (schedule_widget_polls sets Asking); the request is dropped by the stale sweep / reconnect
effect: The widget stops refreshing its public data for as long as the entry lives (Asking is skipped by schedule_widget_polls; came_back only re-arms Due); only replace_content or the entry being removed resets it

title: Cancelling a wallpaper preview while Share is out leaves its answer in background_answers

title: A VoiceCapture dropped without finish/discard leaves its recording on disk (VideoNoteCapture removes its file in Drop; VoiceCapture does not)
trigger: Start a voice note, then switch account / lose the composer / quit while recording so the capture is dropped
effect: Drop stops the mic and detaches the encoder, which finishes the OGG; the file stays in the captures folder, unreferenced, until the media cache sweep
fix: Drop removes the path unless the capture was finished or is a fixture, like VideoNoteCapture::Capture::Finished
